hook_rules: Open inside the 'before' at its worst moment — the frustration, not the backstory. The viewer should recognise their own current state in the first 2 seconds.
connector_rule: BUT / THEREFORE between every beat — never 'and then'. before THEREFORE the turn; the turn BUT it wasn't obvious it would work.
last_dab: End on the after-state as one concrete image plus how to get it, phrased to loop back into the before.

beats.purpose: the starting state at its most painful and specific
the moment / decision / tool that changes things
what actually happened during the shift, briefly
the after state, concrete, plus how to get it
